summary: Iteration 10 (Support / Ticket system) fully verified. Backend: 20 pytest cases across public/user/admin/notify/patch flows — 20 passed, 1 cleanup skipped (handled manually). Frontend: landing footer contact/support-email, public /contact form submit + success, /app/support (nav, new-ticket dialog, thread + reply), /app/admin Support Tickets tab (list, filter, open_count, admin reply -> status pending, priority/status selects) all work. Notification bell present and receives ticket_reply / ticket_status notifications for workspace-scoped tickets. Public ticket admin reply no-notification path also works without errors.

minor.issue: open_count is computed across ALL tickets ignoring the ?status filter. Not necessarily a bug (it's a global badge), but worth documenting: same value returned whether status=open or status=resolved is requested.

X-Workspace-Id header is stored verbatim with no validation (a caller could pass any string / a workspace they don't belong to). Not exploitable for reading tickets — but notifications from admin replies would be routed to whatever workspace was recorded at create time.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Support Tickets tab initial load
integration_issues.issue: tickets-open-count sometimes shows '0 open' briefly on first mount before the query resolves (captured '0 open' from selector even though backend returned 3). Likely a placeholder rendered before data hydrates; not a functional bug.

action_items: (Optional) Consider validating X-Workspace-Id against user membership when creating a ticket to prevent mis-routed admin-reply notifications.
(Optional) Delay rendering of tickets-open-count until the admin list query resolves, or show '—' placeholder to avoid flashing '0 open'.
critical_code_review_comments: support.py is well-scoped (~200 lines), uses uuid ids, excludes _id via _summary/_detail projections — good.
require_platform_admin is enforced on every /admin/* route including PATCH and POST/reply — verified 403 for non-admin.
create_notification is guarded by t.get('workspace_id'); public tickets correctly skip notification without error — verified.
user_reply correctly resets status to 'open'; admin_reply sets 'pending'; admin PATCH sets explicit status. Transitions verified.

Category/priority fallbacks: unknown category coerced to 'other' on public creation but for authenticated create it also coerces (verified indirectly). Priority validation on PATCH returns 400 as expected.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral tickets prefixed with 'TEST '/emails 'test_*@example.com' during tests. All test tickets + related notifications purged via pymongo after runs (delete_many). Demo tickets (Link not redirecting, Billing question) preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_support.py (uses pytest.ini, run with -o addopts='' to disable xdist workers if fixture scope causes cross-worker issues; module-scoped fixtures are fine with default xdist because of --dist loadscope). Cleanup relies on pymongo + backend .env (DB_NAME, MONGO_URL). Notifications assertions read GET /api/notifications with X-Workspace-Id header set to the teammate's current_workspace (their own workspace, since ticket is created there).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only two minor observations documented in action_items.
